text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Orange: AGV, the energy the group takes from the transmission system, in megawatts. Blue: INDDEM, sign reversed, of the zone whose anomaly correlates best with the group (named in the right-hand title). Left: the winter week starting Monday 15 December 2025. Right: the summer week starting Monday 15 June 2026.'
